name: Dodge cars or DIE for ADMIN
desc:
🚘Dodge the cars on your way to the top to access ADMIN!

🧗‍♂️Climb a massive hill while dodging flying cars coming your way to get to the top of the hill to access POWERFUL Admin tools! Hide in holes in the ground to try not get hit and ragdolled down the mountain!

😈TROLL players with a SLAP tool to FLING them down the hill!
👻go GHOST and climb the mountain while being UNTOUCHABLE!
